note: The OLG covers most of the employment data points FNS 1021.1 requires, but through BEACON data entry procedures rather than structured interview/questioning guidance. The BEACON Employed Tab captures: wage type, start date, end date, frequency, hourly wage, hours per week, job title, and permanent status. The Employer Tab captures: employer name, phone, FEIN, and address. The Earnings Tab captures gross income and hours per pay period. Verification is addressed on the 'Types of Earned Income' page (pay stubs, pay envelopes, employer statements). Work Number and PI Checklist matches serve as automated employment verification sources. However, several FNS requirements lack OLG coverage: (1) No guidance on asking about overtime, bonuses, tips, or commissions as distinct income components — the OLG only mentions consulting the household about 'normal' weekly income for hourly/piecework. (2) No instruction to collect payment method (cash, check, direct deposit). (3) No guidance on exploring for unaccounted-for employment based on household expenses that cannot be explained by known income. (4) No explicit instruction to identify whether changes were reported or unreported. (5) The broader IEVS framework is not described — the OLG covers Work Number and PI Checklist matches but does not reference IEVS as a systematic process or describe other IEVS match types for employment verification.
